ios.desc:
Settle the Score.
Tired of that one friend who always claims they "knew it was going to happen" after the fact? Put their reputation to the test with Bernibets, the ultimate social prediction app for friend groups, families, and travel squads.

Whether it’s a big game, a group vacation, a wedding, or just a challenge on who knows their English teacher's quirks best - Bernibets turns every group debate into a fun, competitive game.

HOW IT WORKS

Create or Join a Group: Use a unique invite code to start a private circle for your "Spring Break Squad," "Trivia Night Crew," or even your "Fantasy League Chat."

Launch a Poll: Create a custom question about anything. List the possible outcomes and let the social buzz begin.

Back Your Picks: Use your starting balance of Berni Points to back your predictions. Watch the multipliers shift in real-time as your friends weigh in.

Verify the Result: Once the result is clear, anyone in the group can settle the poll. The group has 24 hours to keep everyone honest and ensure the correct outcome is recorded.

Dominate the Leaderboard: Earn rewards for accurate picks to move up the group rankings. Prove once and for all who really knows their stuff.

KEY FEATURES

Total Customization: You aren't limited to a set list. If your group can argue about it, you can create a poll for it.

Dynamic Social Multipliers: Our custom algorithm updates the reward potential as more friends weigh in. Spot an unlikely trend early to maximize your score.

Integrated Group Chat: Every poll has a dedicated chat thread. Share your "receipts," call out the bad takes, and keep the trash talk flowing.

Private & Secure: Unique invite codes ensure your groups stay within your inner circle.

Sleek Social Graphs: Track your performance and group trends with high-fidelity visuals.

THE "PRIDE" FACTOR
Bernibets is built on the belief that bragging rights are the ultimate reward. There is NO REAL MONEY involved. No deposits, no withdrawals, and no prizes. We use 100% social points for 100% real bragging rights.

Disclaimer:
Bernibets is a social utility for entertainment purposes only. It is a non-commercial, social prediction platform. No real money, currency, or items of value can be won, used, or exchanged within this app.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Friendly prediction markets to turn trips into a running tournament

quotes.text:
On a trip with my friend, he introduced me to Kalshi and Polymarket and was shocked at how degenerate it was being able to bet on literally anything. So naturally I built an app ironically where we could do the same thing (with fake money) on group outings!

Managed to get a prototype finished in time for our big 14-person annual ski trip and we had a blast 'betting' on things like "Will [friend that always breaks his phone] break his phone?" and "Who will win the first game of Jackbox?" Having a low-stakes running leaderboard during our trip was so fun that I decided to flesh it out and share it with others for their trips, wacky professors, etc.

*How It Works*

1. Create a group for your trip and give your friends the group code to join.

2. Everyone starts with the same amount of Tokens/Points/Ski-bux that they can wager on each question.

3. Place bets on the options that you think will win - the more bets on an option, the more it costs to pick that option.

4. Anyone can propose when an outcome has happened and everyone gets 24 hours to dispute it.

5. Every share of the winning option pays out as 1 Token once the 24 hours has passed. So if you bet 2 tokens when the odds were 50%, you win 4 Tokens!

Please let me know what you think and what features I should add to make it even more fun for your friend groups!

---

Requires an account to use, but feel free to use this test account if you just want to peek around: (u: test@test.com - p: 11111111)
